cohort: 1,461 singleton pregnant women aged 12-34 years who delivered between January 2020 and December 2022 at Somdej Phrachao Taksin Maharat Hospital, Thailand
finding: Pregnant women aged 19 or below had significantly higher rates of anemia, preterm birth, and cesarean delivery compared to those over 19 years.
mod_finding: Pregnant women aged 19 or below had significantly higher rates of cesarean delivery compared to those over 19 years.
